s: October 1, 2024 - A projection of uniform circular motion undergoes simple harmonic oscillation. Consider a circle with a radius A, moving at a constant angular speed ω. t: Oscillation - an overview | ScienceDirect Topics
s: The most striking feature of oscillatory motion is its regularity. This regularity is characterized by the time between vibrations. The time required for one complete oscillation of a system or body is called the period, T, of the motion. The frequency of the motion is the number of complete oscillations of the system per unit time, and is designated by the Greek letter v (nu).
